title: Runners report why an implement session ended, and a budget failure fails

story.i_want_to: the runner to report why a session ended and loopctl to act on the reason
story.so_that: a story that fails deterministically ends at failed instead of being re-run in a circle

rationale: Control learns that a session died only through lease expiry, so a wall-clock kill, a turn-budget kill, an exhausted subscription and a crash look identical, and each would be retried. The :budget_exceeded edge exists in the stage machine and has no writer. A reported reason lets each case go where it belongs.

acceptance_criteria.description: The contract accepts an optional session_ended message {dispatch_id, claim_epoch, reason} with reason in completed | wall_clock_exceeded | max_turns_exceeded | usage_exhausted | crashed; any other reason is refused invalid_payload.
wall_clock_exceeded or max_turns_exceeded on an in-flight story takes {stage, failed, :budget_exceeded} and releases the runner's slot.
usage_exhausted releases the claim, re-contracts the story without spending an attempt, and records the runner as exhausted.
crashed releases the claim through the same path lease expiry uses.
A session_ended carrying a stale claim_epoch is refused stale_claim_epoch and changes nothing.
A byte-identical resend of an applied session_ended is answered with the current row and changes nothing.

test_cases.name: unknown reason refused
preconditions: runner with an accepted implement dispatch

test_cases.name: wall clock kill fails the story
preconditions: story at implementing under the dispatch
expected_results: stage failed, edge budget_exceeded, in_flight decremented

test_cases.name: exhaustion spends nothing
expected_results: stage queued, agent_status contracted, attempts unchanged, runner marked exhausted

test_cases.name: crash follows the lease path
expected_results: same stage and agent_status as a reclaim_expired_claim of that story

test_cases.name: stale epoch refused
preconditions: story whose claim_epoch moved past the dispatch's
steps: push session_ended wall_clock_exceeded with the old epoch

technical_notes: Contract: new message in priv/runner_contract/v1.json (1.15.0), handled in LoopctlWeb.RunnerChannel through Loopctl.Delivery.RunnerStages; never a second writer of story_stages
Edge: {in_flight, failed, :budget_exceeded} already in StageMachine.transitions/0 with no writer; make it control-writable for this path only
Runner exhaustion marking is US-44.6's column; until it exists this story records the reason on the dispatch ledger only
non_goals: Does not change what the runner does on its own wall clock
